core.title: Passage Lever for Panic Device, PDQ 6-SH-14-PHL

text.description_html:
Passage Function Lever for Panic Device

This is a Passage Function Lever (Entry by Outside lever - Always unlocked) is suitable for all Wide and Medium Stile Doors (aluminum framed, hollow metal, or wood). For use on door's exterior with Panic Device Hardware. Heavy duty commercial set covers standard 2-1/8" bore hole door prep. Old Item# PDQ-629LPNH

For use with PDQ 6200 Series Rim Exit Device.

Also available: Classroom Function Lever for 6200 Series Panic Device and Night Latch Function Lever for 6200 Series Panic Device

PDQ Philadelphia style lever with round rose. Packaged with mounting hardware and instructions.

Features for PDQ 6-SH-14-PHL Passage Function Lever

  • Passage Function (ANSI F14) - Entry by Outside lever - Always unlocked.
  • Rose Diameter: 3-5/16"
  • Lever Projection: 3-3/8"
  • Lever Length: 5-1/8"
  • Non-Handed
  • ADA Compliant
